page.title: Meals
page.purpose: Hold the meal collection so a person can save a name-only idea, find meals by fit or readiness, and archive without losing pinned history.

priorities.statement: A name-only draft is valid and no field is silently set to zero because an input was empty.
Authoring readiness is visibly separate from current-profile eligibility.
A meal outside the active diet is stored and shown with the reason it is not recommended, never hidden.
Search spans names, aliases, ingredients, and approved tags without calling an external model per keystroke.
Archiving removes a meal from future discovery while pinned revisions in plans and history remain usable.

states.description: The surface at rest with data present; the state a journey step assumes when it names none.
First read of the page's data; layout is reserved so nothing shifts on arrival.
The read succeeded and there is genuinely nothing, which is distinct from not-yet-loaded.
Some contributing data could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
Displayed data is older than its freshness window; its age is shown.
The request failed; the reason and the next available action are stated.
Input was rejected before submission; the offending field is identified next to it.
A write is in flight; the affected control says why it is unavailable.
The client cannot reach the API; read-only or queued behavior is explained.
The evaluator cannot decide eligibility because required evidence is missing or conflicting; the meal is stored and the missing evidence is named.
The search and filter combination matched nothing; the page offers a reset action.
Text organization or extraction failed or arrived after an edit; the original text is preserved and a comparison is offered instead of an overwrite.

claims.statement: Current-profile eligibility is reported separately from authoring readiness and revision, so Ready is never read as diet-safe.
A nonempty trimmed name is sufficient to save a draft, and no unnamed field becomes zero.
A stored meal outside the active diet is shown with the rule or missing evidence that blocks recommendation rather than hidden.
Search spans local names, aliases, ingredients, and approved tags and does not make an external AI call per keystroke.
A no-results state is explicit and offers a reset action rather than an empty grid.
Archiving stops future discovery while pinned revisions remain identifiable and usable in plans and history.
When text organization finishes after a manual edit, the page shows a comparison and preserves the original text instead of overwriting the newer edit.
Search and the collection filters are fully keyboard reachable.
The meal collection reflows from three to two to one column without horizontal document overflow.
